description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. Your Quest   Coretura serves two OEM shareholders who are simultaneously its customers, a structural setup that creates constant, real tension: whose priorities get championed first, how do you keep a platform genuinely common when both owners want to differentiate, and what happens when one side's ask risks disadvantaging the other?  On top of that, the product itself is still under creation, and that creation often means guiding a broader shift from hardware-centric thinking toward a software-first mindset. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform

title: Field Support Manager, Nordics
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: As a Field Support Manager, you will lead and support our Field Support Representatives (FSR) across the Nordics, helping them deliver an excellent experience for our Companion Animal Group (CAG) customers. This is a field-based role, ideally located in the Nordics (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark), with around 50% travel to visit teams and customers.  The Companion Animal Group (CAG) is responsible for installing and supporting our best-in-class premium instruments, including ProCyte, Catalyst One and SediVue, alongside the wider IDEXX analyzer portfolio. Our FSR team trains customers to get the most from their newly acquired instruments and provides onsite technical support when things don't go to plan. As a Field Support Manager, you'll build and develop this team so they can keep delivering excellent service across the region.   In This Role     You will lead and support the FSR team across the UK, contributing to FSR strategy, operating policies and process improvements.  You'll coach and develop individuals to deliver excellent customer experience, spotting opportunities and assigning the right resources.  You'll partner with field partners to identify opportunities and coordinate resources across the region.  You will guide territory management, helping the team prioritise and allocate their time so internal and external customers stay satisfied.  You'll join ride-alongs with field reps to provide hands-on training and individual development.  You will use data, metrics and system tools to drive efficiency and maximise customer experience.  You'll act as a change champion, supporting the team through periods of change.  You will evaluate performance and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.  You'll help representatives organise travel to customers, resolve issues, and keep site-visit reporting timely and accurate.  You've worked cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate work, resolve issues, and share customer feed

description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

title: Senior IT Manager, Contractor
description:
ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

title: Senior Account Executive, Nordics & Baltics
description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

Sonatype is expanding its presence across Northern Europe, and we are looking for a Senior Account Executive to lead revenue growth across the Nordics and Baltics region. As software development accelerates through AI coding assistants and open source ingestion, software supply chain security has become a strategic, board-level priority for global enterprise organizations.

Joining one of Sonatype’s top-performing global sales teams, you will own a high-growth territory with a dual mandate: acquiring high-value enterprise new logos and expanding existing customer adoption. Using Sonatype Firewall as a high-velocity commercial wedge, you will partner cross-functionally to scale our market visibility while building trust-based, long-term customer partnerships. This role is ideal for an autonomous, commercially disciplined sales professional who thrives in a high-accountability environment and is driven to raise the performance bar.

title: Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen dich!

Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten Sales Development (m/w/d), der uns dabei unterstützt, noch mehr Unternehmen für bessere Kundenkommunikation zu begeistern.

Jeden Tag helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten. Damit noch mehr Unternehmen von unseren Lösungen profitieren können, möchten wir unseren Kundenstamm gezielt erweitern und neue Kontakte aufbauen.

Du hast Freude daran, dich in Unternehmen einzulesen, die richtigen Ansprechpartner zu identifizieren und den ersten Kontakt herzustellen? Du bist neugierig, kommunizierst gerne und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus der Ruhe bringen? Dann passt du zu uns.

Vorerfahrungen im Vertrieb sind dabei kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du Interesse an Menschen, Unternehmen und guter Kommunikation mitbringst. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team. Nach deiner Einarbeitung kannst du überwiegend remote arbeiten. Für Trainings, Feedbackgespräche, Teamtage oder andere wichtige Termine freuen wir uns, wenn du nach Absprache an einem unserer Standorte dabei bist.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du recherchierst Unternehmen, die zu unseren Zielkunden passen.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Ansprechpartner und pflegst Informationen in unserem CRM.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache potenzieller Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und LinkedIn.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche mit Interessenten und prüfst gemeinsam mit dem Team, ob ein passender Bedarf besteht.
  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam.
  • Du dokumentierst Aktivitäten und Erkenntnisse sauber in unseren Systemen.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ansprachesequenzen weiter und testest, welche Ansätze gut funktionieren.
  • Du gibst Rückmeldungen aus Gesprächen und Recherchen an Vertrieb und Marketing weiter.
